80:2.text: Because there came to him the blind man
(i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs)

80:3.text: And how can you know that he might become pure

80:4.text: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?

80:5.text: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

80:7.text: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure
(from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh)

80:8.text: But as to him who came to you running,

80:10.text: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

80:12.text: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

80:18.text: From what thing did He create him?

80:19.text: He created him and then set him in due proportion.

80:20.text: Then He makes the Path easy for him.

80:21.text: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.

80:22.text: Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him

80:23.text: has not done what He commanded him.

80:24.text: Then let man look at his food:

80:25.text: We pour forth water in abundance.

80:26.text: And We split the earth in clefts.

80:27.text: And We cause therein the grain to grow,

80:30.text: And gardens dense with many trees,

80:32.text: a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

80:33.text: (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection)

80:34.text: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,

80:35.text: And from his mother and his father,

80:36.text: And from his wife and his children.

80:37.text: Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.

80:38.text: Some faces that Day will be bright

80:40.text: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained.

80:42.text: (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.)
